commit_message:
[top-level-await] fix async evaluation with errored async parent

Updates a CHECK to support EVALUATING-ASYNC modules.

Updates GatherAvailableAncestors to check kErrored before
calling AsyncEvaluationOrdinalCompare to prevent hitting DCHECK.

fix_commit_message:
[module] Fix bug with uninitialized CycleRoot property

This CL prevents a type confusion (hole leak) arising when an async
parent module depends on an async child but also fails synchronously.

It also contains a tiny polishing in d8.cc.

Bug: 439986081
Change-Id: I5c05e94d6944dab150c075407eeb19cdbdb0af79
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/6895977
Commit-Queue: Nikolaos Papaspyrou <nikolaos@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Leszek Swirski <leszeks@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/main@{#102127}
agent_reasoning: Without the added check, GetCycleRoot(isolate) is invoked unconditionally on every async parent module during ancestor gathering. GetCycleRoot() casts the module's cycle_root field directly to a SourceTextModule handle. For a parent module that fails synchronously while depending on an async child, cycle_root is never assigned and remains the uninitialized hole value. Calling ->status() on that casted hole treats the Hole oddball as if it were a SourceTextModule object, reading a 'status' field at an offset into memory that isn't actually a module object header — a type confusion that can leak or corrupt memory. The fix guards the call with `!IsTheHole(m->cycle_root(), isolate)` so GetCycleRoot() is only dereferenced when cycle_root has actually been initialized, eliminating the type confusion while preserving the original intent of the spec-derived check.
